en.bdb: The higher one is alone is not respectable

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਥੈ ਤਿਵੜੀ ਬਾਮਣੈ ਸਉਹੇ ਆਏ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਫੇਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: mathai tivaRee baamanai sauhe aae masalat feree|

en.bdb: If going out doors one comes across a brahmin (who is proud of his high caste in India), the traditional people consider it

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੁ ਉਚਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਵਲ ਦੇ ਪਗ ਵਲਾਏ ਡੇਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: sir uchaa aha(n)kaar kar val dhe pag valaae dderee|

en.bdb: The head being proud of its high place is tied with turban.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀਂ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਪੂਜੀਅਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਨਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਤੇਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: akhee(n) mool na poojeean kar kar vekhan meree teree|

en.bdb: Eyes are also not adored because they see with the sense of duality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਕੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪੂਜਦਾ ਖਾਇ ਮਰੋੜੀ ਮਣੀ ਘਨੇਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: nak na koiee poojadhaa khai maroRee manee ghaneree|

en.bdb: Nose is also not worshipped because on seeing a low person the nose is turned up to show disdain.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਚੇ ਕੰਨ ਨ ਪੂਜੀਅਨਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਭਲੀ ਭਲੇਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: auche ka(n)n na poojeean usatat ni(n)dhaa bhalee bhaleree|

en.bdb: Though placed higher, the ears are also not worshipped because they listen to the eulogy as well as slander.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਜੀਭ ਨ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਬਹੁ ਚਖੀ ਦੰਦ ਘੇਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: bolahu jeebh na poojeeaai ras kas bahu chakhee dha(n)dh gheree|

en.bdb: Tongue is also not worshipped because it is also surrounded by teeth and tastes both edibles and inedibles.
Only because of being the lowest, the feet are touched with hands in worshipful reverence.
